title: Replay sharpening and cross-entropy diagnostic

setting.sampling: Last diagnostic sample at or before each pass boundary; steps 330 through 6740.

metrics.mean_entropy: mean full-vocabulary softmax entropy in nats
metrics.mean_ptrue: mean probability assigned to the observed next token
metrics.val_ce: mean validation cross-entropy for the true next token, in nats

interpretation: Shape metrics and true-token CE are separate axes. The diagnostic is finite-budget evidence within the listed setting; it does not establish universal or indefinite sharpening.
groups: Frequency is the training count of the context. novel (F=0) denotes an unseen context, not an unseen continuation of a seen context.
